our noise-robust estimation approach is a powerful technique to deal with high-frequency data under market microstructure noise, and that it provides the most general and flexible solution to the estimation problem for high-frequency data in the presence of market microstructure noise.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the noise-robust estimator is a generalization of its non-noise counterpart, where the latter is a special case of the former.
the technology is a unified framework for constructing noise-robust high-frequency data estimators.
the existing estimators are noise-robust, provided that the limit order book data is used to construct the efficient price estimator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a given high-frequency estimator, there exists a corresponding noise-robust version, which is easy to implement, and is asymptotically efficient under parametric noise.
